status_message: Sketchware AI v2.1.4 is required: the GitHub sign-in code goes in by itself (also on GitHub's Confirm access page), Publish fits on one screen and writes the description for you, and the Play Store shows Follow, creator levels and countries. Tap Update: it installs over this version and your projects stay.
update_reason: This update is required: it fixes problems in the version you have, and that version is no longer supported. It installs over it: your projects, settings and GitHub sign-in stay.
update_notes: Sign-in: E-mail me a code; a copied code goes in by itself
Publish: one-line project, description written from your project
Play Store: Follow with followers, creator levels and country
